name: com.wyrdmcp/wyrd-scribe
description: Creates new pages with provenance and records lineage in a ledger under .wyrd/.

packageArguments.name: --grant
packageArguments.description: Folder where pages may be created. It must already contain a .wyrd/ directory. Wins over WYRD_GRANT.

environmentVariables.name: WYRD_GRANT
environmentVariables.description: Folder where pages may be created. It must already contain a .wyrd/ directory. Used when --grant is absent.

environmentVariables.name: WYRD_SCRIBE_TIER
environmentVariables.description: Selects tier A by default. Tier B adds guarded page overwrites. Tier C is recognized but this build refuses to start with it.
